# DINOv2 feature-extraction notebook — fleet-sweep fixes

**Source:** the 2026-10-05 static fleet sweep of `main` flagged this notebook for three `assert` lines that compare a
quality metric. This is a targeted fix; **no full Notebook Review Framework v1 review has been done** in this cycle
(the 2026-10-02 review and its fixes are already on `main`).
**Base:** `main` at `aa1f7b1`.
**Notebook:** `tutorials/dinov2_feature_extraction_colab.ipynb`, regenerated by `tools/build_notebook.py`.
**Readiness:** **Verification pending.** The fix is verified offline only; a hosted one-pass Run all is still required.
**Status labels:** unchanged (`STATUS.md`, release status and `clean_runtime_evidence` are left for the maintainer).

The notebook already runs its model stages in the isolated `uv` environment (no in-kernel install, no restart guard)
and carries the guided layer, so SWP-R and SWP-G do not apply. The diff is limited to the assert→verdict change in the
template, the validator markers, the regression tests and this record.

## User-visible changes

- Section 6 prints `{'frozen_vs_majority_floor': ..., 'frozen_accuracy': ..., 'floor_accuracy': ...}` instead of
  stopping when the probe is not above the floor.
- Section 8 prints `{'verdicts': {...}}` as a row of the comparison; `comparison['verdicts']` is a new key in the
  evaluation report and in `result.json`. A BYOD run whose selected policy is at or below the majority floor now
  completes the export, the reload-parity check and `result.json`.
- The default sample path computes the same numbers as before (the recorded run: floor 0.1667, frozen 0.8333,
  selected 0.8333 → verdicts `above the majority floor`, `above the majority floor`, `no gain`).
